title: Y2038SafeEventPayload
description: JSON Schema enforcing Y2038-safe 64-bit integer timestamps and ISO-8601 strings.

timestamp_epoch_sec.description: 64-bit signed Unix epoch timestamp in seconds.

timestamp_epoch_ms.description: 64-bit signed Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

timestamp_iso8601.description: ISO-8601 formatted timestamp string in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).
